collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLS Saloon 2004 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description:
All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLS Saloon 2004 to 2010 (219) model which requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers.

This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
